# A Hidden Sky Above New York City

Using a special invisible-light filter, this photographer captured our Milky Way galaxy blazing over New York City by detecting heat-like infrared radiation that our eyes can't see—a clever trick that blocks most modern LED and fluorescent pollution while letting stars shine through. This stunning image reveals that even in the world's brightest city, the cosmos still waits above us, reminding us that the universe connects all of humanity regardless of where we live.
